Yesterday, I stopped by the Lancaster County Sheriff’s office to celebrate a great Nebraskan.

Sheriff Terry Wagner is retiring after 32 years in the role.  He was previously a deputy and has been with the Lancaster County Sheriff’s office since 1976.

Congratulations Terry!

It was great to be at Guardian Angels Homecare today.

The Fultons have served Lincoln families with their home care agency since 2003.

Small businesses like this one employ almost 50% of Nebraskans.

This is Small Business Week.

I’m glad to celebrate small business and share how the Working Families Tax Cuts will strengthen small businesses like Guardian Angels.

Today, I was able to present the Nebraska Cattlemen with a Capitol flag.

Together, we are celebrating National Beef Month.

Nebraska is the beef state. Our ranchers are the best in the world.

They’ve shown it this year in response to this spring’s devastating fires across the state. I’m confident they will rebuild and I’m grateful to honor them in the month of May.

Any antitrust allegations in our meatpacking industry should be investigated to the full extent of the law.

I called for this as Governor during the Biden Administration and reiterate it today with the DOJ’s announcement.

Nebraska’s farmers, ranchers, and consumers deserve this transparency.
foxbusiness.com/economy/doj-…
Kawasaki manufactures various components at this facility including the Metro cars found in our Nation’s Capitol in Washington DC.

Today, I met with Kawasaki in Lincoln.

For over five decades, Kawasaki has been an integral part of Lincoln’s community.

The 2,500 workers here represent some of the best talent, ingenuity, and commitment you’ll find anywhere in the world.

I was excited to share how they will benefit with the Working Families Tax Cuts!

Congratulations to the 90 Nebraska students who were honored at the fourth annual High School Enlistee Recognition Ceremony in Ashland. These young Nebraskans are making the ultimate commitment to service. I’m thankful to them and their families, and wish them the best of luck as they begin their careers in the armed forces!
journalstar.com/news/local/e…

Congratulations to the 35 Nebraska students who signed letters of intent to enter into skilled trades and technical services at Metropolitan Community College's South Omaha campus.

I’ve supported programs like this since I was Governor. Programs like the Nebraska Youth Registered Apprenticeship Program give students hands on skills for future opportunities.
omaha.com/news/local/educati…

Kevin Warsh is a great nominee, I am proud of my vote to advance him through Banking Committee.

In the last 78 years, no Fed Chair has stayed on the Board of Governors past their term. Jay Powell should not treat himself as an exception.


Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent (@SecScottBessent)

It is unusual for soon-to-be-former Fed Chair Jay Powell to stay on at the @federalreserve. For someone who speaks so often of norms, his unilateral decision to stay flies in the face of tradition.

Kevin W

The Chinese Communist Party has targeted sensitive sites surrounding military installations like Grand Forks Air Force Base in North Dakota and Fort Bragg in North Carolina. A Chinese national was recently arrested after taking sensitive photos of airframes outside of Offutt Airforce Base last week. This is a serious national security threat.

I introduced the bipartisan AFIDA Improvements Act to strengthen foreign ag land reporting. It increases transparency and information sharing. It would al
Best of luck to the students from Lincoln East High School and Elkhorn Valley View Middle School at the 2026 National Science Bowl Finals here in Washington!  You represent Nebraska well.

As of 2023, Communist China owned more than 277,000 acres of farmland. I’m leading efforts to improve oversight of ag land ownership by foreign adversaries.

Recently, I introduced the Property Location Oversight and Transparency, or PLOT, Act.

The bill increases USDA’s oversight of foreign purchases of American farmland. It would lower reporting thresholds to capture smaller foreign ownership stakes that currently go unreported.

The PLOT Act also requires USDA to provide digital maps of purch

Right now, I’m fighting to pay our brave ICE and Border Patrol officers.

As Democrats fight to defund the police, Senate Republicans are supporting law enforcement. With the Working Families Tax Cuts, we invested in border security and enforcement. We’re combatting the drug cartels at the border.

On Fentanyl Awareness Day, I’m praying for the families impacted by this drug.

Senate Republicans are committed to ending this scourge.

I also introduced the Nitazene Sanctions Act.

Nitazenes are a class of drug that is even deadlier than fentanyl.

By cracking down on drug dealers and cartels, we’re making our streets safer.

In the Senate, I’m fighting to bring an end to the flow of fentanyl.

We passed and Trump signed the HALT Fentanyl Act into law. The law permanently classifies fentanyl and its analogues as Schedule I substances.  It leads to harsher sentences for fentanyl traffickers.

Less fentanyl means fewer overdose deaths.

Taryn Lee Griffith was a 24-year-old single mom of two when she died of an overdose in Lincoln. She took what she believed was a prescription pill while out with friends. She had no idea that pill had been laced with a lethal dose of fentanyl. Her tragedy is all too familiar.

In my last year as Governor, state troopers confiscated 2 times as much methamphetamine, 3 times as much fentanyl, and 10 times as much cocaine as just two years prior.  They did this work despite the Biden Administration’s terrible open border policies.

President Joe Biden had four years of open border policies.

We saw a surge of fentanyl coming into our country — fentanyl that is killing our young people.

In just one month under Biden, law enforcement intercepted 1,400 pounds of fentanyl coming into our country. That’s enough to kill 300 MILLION Americans.

Today is Fentanyl Awareness Day.

Americans elected President Trump and Senate Republicans to secure the border and stop the flow of fentanyl. We’re delivering.

Enjoyed attending the joint address from King Charles III to Congress today. As America celebrates our 250th birthday this year, I appreciate the King making the trip to support and help renew our special relationship.
